summary: Today turned into yet another expansion day. I underestimated how much space the forestry machines would require, so most of the day was spent clearing terrain and extending the sector to fit the new tree farm layout.
The forestry expansion is significantly larger than I initially expected, but it should allow the base to produce a much larger supply of wood once everything is operational.
Aside from clearing land for the forestry sector, I also constructed a new water processing plant consisting of twelve precipitation tanks dedicated to producing clean water.
The layout of this new plant was designed with future expansion in mind. The system can be easily doubled if additional water throughput becomes necessary.

Tar processing is once again being delayed. While the technology is now available, I decided it would be better to focus on one major project at a time. For now, that priority is expanding wood production.
Once the forestry sector is fully operational, I will revisit tar processing and finally begin implementing the new recipes that should help solve the stone shortage.
On the research front, I completed two additional iterations of the Additional Chunk technology to secure enough territory for the expanding forestry sector.
I also researched Repair Packs, which will finally allow me to repair turrets and other structures damaged by meteorite impacts without having to replace them entirely.

My next research project will be Nanobots. If the technology works the way I hope it does, it should significantly assist with construction and repair tasks so I no longer have to manually build or fix every structure myself.
